race.comment: MIRRA IMPACT (1) kicked off the prep with a win back in July and while he's yet to salute again, he's going as good as ever. Hasn't been beaten far in his last two in Saturday metro company, and only needs to hold his form here prove hard to beat. MAZIS (4) has been below his best in his last two, yet his profile around this distance and at this venue is strong enough to make him a serious rebound candidate. Even more so with Thompson's booking. SUPER FAIR (8) never got involved here in the LR QLD Cup but drops significantly in grade from that and gets in light with Youngberry's claim. Expect her to drift back from the draw and be warming late. FAMILY OF LEAGUE (9) didn't give her rivals a sniff last start over this trip at the Sunny Coast when leading pillar-to-post on a heavy deck. Is a live chance to still it again if left alone in front.
